strength.method: Person-icon HUD counts at 5-second sampling. Two English recognizers agree on two digits at confidence >=0.92 in both, with visible ticket HUD, plus separately logged visual reviews. Missing readings remain null; no smoothing or interpolated flags. Observed runs end on missing or <=33 readings. Selected peaks are checked separately; entire series is not manually verified.

source_recording.pov: PHNT clan recording; supplied by clan member
source_recording.timing: Recording timestamps; 4Hz feed and 5-second HUD samples use upward-rounded source bins, within one source frame (0.017s).

feed_method.inclusion: At least 3 distinct source frames and OCR score >=0.80, or 2 source frames with both recognizers agreeing at >=0.92; separate visual reviews.
feed_method.limits: Motion blur, foliage and compressed HUD text. Unreadable and isolated single-name rows are not automatically classified. No whole-match accuracy or final-kill claim.

feed_sample_check.limitations: Three selected development spot-check windows, not a held-out test or whole-match accuracy estimate. Matching tolerates OCR spelling differences and measures episode recovery, not exact name accuracy. Automatic results precede separately logged visual corrections. Reference images are sampled at one-second intervals with an additional quarter-second window-end check. Unmatched predictions may be fragments or additional displays; they are not all proven false positives.

meta.opponent_names_source: Visible in-game clan tags and faction glyphs; full clan names not independently confirmed
meta.notes: PHNT clan recording, Blue / Lonestar vs Red AK and Green PMF on Ozeti. Analysis begins at 06:10 with 0–0–0 after the prior-round ending and loading transition. Active-HUD extraction ends at 2:16:45; final result separately checked at 2:17:00: Red 100, Blue 96, Green 96. The result screen awards PHNT second place. Opponent labels are the visible in-game tags.
